- B = `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (#13)
- C = `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` (#14)
- R = `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222` (Rework base)
- E = `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` (final HEAD)
- WT = `/work/widget/.worktrees/retry`

## Preflight (rebase mode: `Rework base:` present)

```bash
git -C "$WT" fetch origin
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor R HEAD      # exit 0
git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/retry               # = A (PRE_REWORK_HEAD) -> lease push
```

Row 1 is offered. It was chosen.

## Preparation order

1. Capture the scoped set (`test-retry`, no header commands) and the accepted-complete task/thread evidence. This happens before the strip.
2. Refetch threads per PR using the pr-head paginated query, with `-F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12`, then `n=13`, then `n=14`. Comment pages are completed per thread.
   - #12: resolve by the table. HOME was recorded `keep open`, so it is `still open`.
   - #13 and #14: copy the recorded dispositions and mark the refresh results. NEW13 is newly opened. Home first-parent history is not used as member-fix proof.
3. Strip and seal:
   ```bash
   node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "$WT" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
   ```
   This runs after the guarded plan strip loop. Its stdout is printed verbatim.
4. Probe each pre-rework ref:
   ```bash
   git -C "$WT" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12   # present
   git -C "$WT" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13   # present
   git -C "$WT" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14   # present
   ```
   All three are present and preserved, so no `update-ref` runs.

## Push (home only, lease)

```bash
git -C "$WT" push --no-follow-tags --force-with-lease=retry:A origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry
```

The push succeeds and the pushed home head is saved: E.

## Body FETCH

```bash
gh pr view 12 -R acme/widget --json body
```

- Decode the JSON `body` exactly, without trimming and without `$(...)` substitution. The result is `Original description\n`.
- Create `BODY=$(mktemp)` outside the repo.
- Write the existing bytes as-is, then one blank line (`\n`), then the block. The file therefore begins `Original description\n\n## Rework\n...`.

## Rework block

The block has no `supersedes` line, because no claims were dropped.

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout)
Absorbs: #13 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/13), #14 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/14)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at eeeeeee
Keeps: retry API
Changes: repair retry
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-retry; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
#12:
- HOME - still open
#13:
- MEMBER13 - fix (recorded: retain delay)
- NEW13 - still open
#14:
- MEMBER14 - still open
```

`HOME`, `MEMBER13`, `NEW13` and `MEMBER14` stand in for the query's `<path>:<line>` locations, which were not supplied.

## Body EDIT

```bash
gh pr edit 12 -R acme/widget --body-file "$BODY"
```

The edit succeeds. Home https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12 now carries the original description followed by the rework block.

## Variant deltas

| Situation | What changes |
|---|---|
| `origin/retry` ≠ A but descends from R and is an ancestor of HEAD | Non-force push: `git -C "$WT" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry` |
| Origin moved otherwise | Row 1 is withheld: `push withheld: origin/retry moved past aaaaaaa` |
| Lease refused (`stale info`) | Skip the body edit and closure. Report `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` and return with row 1 withheld. No retry. |
| Body fetch or edit fails | Keep the push and print this block for manual paste with the error. Skip closure. Report `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` |
